title: Book Three · Chapter 58: The Clear Voice
story:
On Friday, the science teacher asks each pair to explain one part of yesterday's work.

Kai looks at Ronan. His written answer is longer now, but he keeps one hand over its last line.

“You talk?” he asks.

“You work the switch?”

Kai nods at once.

When their turn comes, they take a small board from the shelf and set their parts on it. Then they carry it to the front. Ronan stands beside Kai with the paper.

The first row looks up. At the back, someone is still moving a chair.

Ronan starts too quietly. His first sentence disappears under the noise.

He stops. He puts the paper on the desk and waits until the chair is still.

His fingers feel unsteady. He puts one hand flat on the desk and points with the other.

“Watch the bulb,” he says, more clearly.

Kai closes the switch. The little light comes on.

“Now watch here.”

Ronan points to the metal strip. Kai lifts it. There is a small gap, and the light goes out.

“The path is open here. The light goes out.”

He asks Kai to close it again. Then he lifts the loose end of another wire.

The bulb goes dark.

“Ronan is a switch too,” Kai says.

The class laughs. Ronan holds the wire higher.

“A large one. It needs lunch.”

Anna laughs at the front. The boy beside her asks to see the gap again.

Ronan puts the wire down slowly, then lifts it once more. This time he does not hurry through the explanation.

The teacher asks one question about the metal strip. Kai points to both sides and gives a short answer. Ronan adds the last sentence.

Then they carry the board back. Another pair takes its place.

Kai sits down and lets out a long breath.

“I thought you would read all of mine.”

“I couldn't. Your hand was on it.”

Kai looks at his page. His palm has left a damp patch near the end.

Ronan moves his bottle away and gives the paper more room to dry.

At lunch, two boys come over with a question about their wires. Ronan looks at the drawing they made.

He does not know their answer. He asks Kai to look too.

Kai turns the page round. “Show me the parts after lunch.”

The boys agree and stay to eat beside them. Soon everyone is talking about the large switch with the empty stomach.

Anna puts one piece of carrot on a clean corner of Ronan's lunch box.

“For the switch.”

He eats it seriously. “Working again.”

Kai grins and opens his own lunch. There are four boxes near the desk now. Ronan moves his notebook, makes space for them, and takes another bite.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

pair＝两人一组；metal strip＝金属片；palm＝手掌；stomach＝胃、肚子。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan刚开始说话时遇到什么问题？他怎样让同学听清并看见动作？
2. 其他同学来问问题时，他有没有假装自己全会？Kai在展示中做了哪些部分？

## 读句子

**He puts the paper on the desk and waits until the chair is still.**

拆开看：He / puts the paper on the desk / and waits until the chair is still.

他／把纸放在桌上／等到椅子不再挪动。
